decision_authority: Coordinator approved this prospective12-arm menu before any validation analysis
candidate_budget_contract: At most32 immutable shared O-lens samples per cell; N16 uses the original nested prefix; source read cells and output caps remain frozen
prospective_revision_reason: Protect the20-hour execution window while remaining DEV judge arms are operationally incomplete; no change to thresholds, source cells, judge endpoints or inference semantics
pending_development_policy: Later DEV results are descriptive only and cannot add VAL arms, retune thresholds or change this selection procedure after validation opens

validation_selection.procedure: Manual documented selection using all four family outcomes, original item aggregation and paired cell metrics, practical effects, coverage, systematic traces, collateral regressions, new-input inference cost and uncertainty
validation_selection.primary_priority: Maximum explanation quality and broadly useful methods; a useful family-specific gain may still merit follow-up
validation_selection.uncertainty: Paired related-group intervals by family; no significance cutoff and no hidden pooled macro
validation_selection.trace_selection: Deterministic distinct-item wins/regressions plus seeded unchanged examples; preserve raw baseline/new text and judge evidence; do not feed these to inference helpers
validation_selection.coverage: Require original-grid cell coverage and both hallucination stages; failures remain missing, never successful abstentions
validation_selection.substantial_numerical_loss: A substantial chain/MT recovery loss requires an explicit practical tradeoff; a small error-rate decrease alone cannot justify it or support a claim of global improvement
validation_selection.combo_assessment: Compare Emean+prune.005 against Emean, A32+prune.005 and A32, plus both parent-specific matched random deletions
validation_selection.no_forced_winner: If candidates offer no convincing practical gain, preserve the negative/inconclusive result rather than force a new deployment method

test_policy: Test generation and analysis remain sealed. Freeze at most2 chosen settings, final comparator/component/shortening controls and evaluation recipe in a separate manifest after VAL selection and before TEST; no test-selected operating point

judge_contract.upstream_prompts_and_aggregation: Pinned WorkspaceBench92d763e; hall both stages, MT regex, chain final-token grid, role all frozen sites

limits: Completed A32 gains do not isolate extra sampling from reconstruction selection.
Role identity matching and hallucination unsupported-versus-contradictory labels have documented sensitivity.
Chain development has only7 related groups; intervals cannot establish broad robustness.
Random32 is one frozen same-pool draw, not a population random-method estimate or a32-sample deployment requirement.
Validation analyses select settings, so their intervals are exploratory; TEST provides the separate final evaluation.

selection_solver.fit_inputs: Centered/whitened target retains magnitude; centered/whitened phrase rows normalized by norm+1e-9
selection_solver.compatibility_only: Released80-iteration projected-gradient fit is diagnostic, not the VAL primary selector

whitening.convention: Symmetrize covariance in float64; ridge=max(.1*mean(diag(cov)),1e-12); inverse sqrt of nonnegative eigenvalues plus ridge; transform=(x-mu)@W.T; source-bound in reconstruction.py

encoding_execution.key_order: First occurrence in immutable flat snapshot, sample order then parser bullet order; retain that order within partitions
encoding_execution.inherited_DEV_rows: Keep first-computed exact effective-key DEV rows unchanged, including recorded or explicitly unavailable historical batch metadata; no B32-to-B128 equivalence claim
encoding_execution.shared_catalog: One common merged vector catalog across every VAL arm; prepared plan must bind exact ordered partition hashes and inherited catalog before encoding
encoding_execution.limits: Expanded DEV batch check failed provisional raw and FVE equivalence guards (max FVE drift .003524); D32 changed2/12 and E1 changed1/12 texts. Near-threshold/near-zero decisions remain sensitive; do not retune threshold using VAL.

fixed_DEV_control_bank.policy: Use unchanged previously assigned DEV donors and fixed read-site metadata; exclude target-related group; no VAL/TEST donor redraw or gold-derived control selection

randomness.digest: SHA256 of canonical sort-key compact UTF8 JSON, ensure_ascii=False
randomness.policy: Frozen per-cell seeds; no redraw based on observed outcomes

inference_contract.invalid_AR_policy: Raw/capped/random text preserved with unavailable fits; complete A/E exclude unscoreable samples, pooling excludes invalid atoms; unscoreable N1 pruning is an explicit no-op; fixed intended denominators

future_test_scheduling_note: Current TEST gate remains closed. A separately reviewed prospective generation-only blind preparation policy may be documented in028; this freeze neither authorizes TEST generation nor changes the requirement to freeze final methods before any TEST AR/analysis.
